headline: SCHD’s 0.06% Fee Hides the Real Cost: How March Reconstitution Triggered $0.8241 Per Share in Surprise Distributions
summary: SCHD charges just 0.06% per year, but taxable investors who lived through the March reconstitution discovered a second bill arriving in a very different form. Here is what the expense ratio line was never designed to show you.
